query:
-- BPMN 2.0 §7 (activities), §8 (gateways, events), §9 (swimlanes), §10 (data), §11 (artifacts).
SELECT * FROM (VALUES
  ('task'::text, 'rounded rectangle, thin border'::text, 'composition'::text, true,
   'pm:Operation, reached by ForeignId'::text, NULL::text),
  ('callActivity', 'rounded rectangle, thick border', 'composition', true,
   'asrt:Part crossing a document. The thick border is the notation for substitution, so this glyph is what a compose directive renders as, and drawing it like a task discards the pipeline', NULL),
  ('subProcess', 'rounded rectangle with the ⊞ marker', 'composition', false,
   NULL, 'Withdrawn after being spent, which is the only row here on that path. A local fusion written as this says the wrong thing twice: a subProcess is an activity inside a lane where a fusion''s parts partition one, and it is a flow node, so it leaves layer grain exactly as a callActivity does. `childLaneSet` says the true thing and stays keyed (filing, layer). Withheld on the composition axis, which the ceded law refuses outright, so it is legible only through diagrams/admitted.sqlc'),
  ('childLaneSet', 'a laneSet nested inside one lane', 'composition', true,
   'The recursion equivalence, and BPMN had the element all along. A fusion''s parts partition what they compose, and this is a sub-partition. A nested lane is still keyed (filing, layer), so unlike a call it collapses nothing and can invent nothing', NULL),
  ('transaction', 'double-bordered rounded rectangle', 'routing', false,
   NULL, 'a rollback boundary, and nothing here can be undone. A remainder is an accounting fact and not an effect, so there is no state to restore'),
  ('adHocSubProcess', 'rounded rectangle with the ~ marker', 'routing', false,
   NULL, 'The near miss. The tilde declares its children have no required order, and siblings here genuinely have none. But F does order them: rank is the evaluation order, and a jagged partition is exactly what separates rank from depth. Drawing this would erase the one order this model has'),
  ('userTask', 'rounded rectangle, person marker', 'performer', false,
   NULL, 'a subtype names who performs, and the performer is the claimant graph, which has no table and files no edges. Emitting one would guess an attribution nothing filed'),
  ('serviceTask', 'rounded rectangle, gear marker', 'performer', false,
   NULL, 'the claimant graph again, and this is the row EU review turns on: software and an AI agent are both claimants here and BPMN spells both as this one glyph'),
  ('manualTask', 'rounded rectangle, hand marker', 'performer', false, NULL, 'the claimant graph: no edges filed'),
  ('scriptTask', 'rounded rectangle, script marker', 'performer', false, NULL, 'the claimant graph: no edges filed'),
  ('businessRuleTask', 'rounded rectangle, table marker', 'performer', false,
   NULL, 'nearest to a regime citation, and wrong: a rule task is a node that evaluates a rule, where pm.regime is the authority a figure is filed under'),
  ('sendTask', 'rounded rectangle, filled envelope', 'routing', false, NULL, 'a message, and there is no token to carry one'),
  ('receiveTask', 'rounded rectangle, open envelope', 'routing', false, NULL, 'a message, and there is no token to carry one'),
  ('performer', 'none, an attribute of an activity', 'performer', false,
   NULL, 'The element the third graph would use, and the reason it is empty. Delegation is a claimant-to-claimant edge and nothing in the schema files one, so this is a slot with no filler rather than a refusal'),

  ('exclusiveGateway', 'diamond with an X', 'routing', false, NULL, '§1: BPMN owns what happens next and under what condition. There is no token here to route'),
  ('parallelGateway', 'diamond with a +', 'routing', false, NULL, '§1: routing. And a fusion is not this: a fusion sums a carrier, a parallel gateway splits a token'),
  ('inclusiveGateway', 'diamond with an O', 'routing', false, NULL, '§1: routing'),
  ('eventBasedGateway', 'diamond with a pentagon', 'routing', false, NULL, '§1: routing, and it needs events, which is the next block'),
  ('complexGateway', 'diamond with an asterisk', 'routing', false, NULL, '§1: routing'),

  ('startEvent', 'thin circle', 'routing', false,
   NULL, 'The precondition is held and not by this element. §3 owes that the expansion has a start and an end, and F holds it structurally, by having a root and having leaves. A startEvent is where a token enters, which is a different claim'),
  ('endEvent', 'thick circle', 'routing', false,
   NULL, 'the leaves of F are the end, and composition/leaves.sqlc is where that is countable'),
  ('intermediateCatchEvent', 'double circle', 'routing', false, NULL, '§1: no token, no clock'),
  ('intermediateThrowEvent', 'double circle, filled marker', 'routing', false, NULL, '§1: no token, no clock'),
  ('boundaryEvent', 'double circle on an activity edge', 'routing', false, NULL, '§1: an interruption is a control-flow event'),
  ('timerEventDefinition', 'clock face', 'routing', false,
   NULL, '§1 says there is no clock, and a window is not one. pm:window is a calendar extent: it says over what span a figure was measured, never when anything fires'),
  ('messageEventDefinition', 'envelope', 'routing', false, NULL, '§1: no token'),
  ('errorEventDefinition', 'lightning bolt', 'routing', false, NULL, 'Not a violation. A check reports a contradiction between filed sentences; an error event is a runtime throw'),
  ('signalEventDefinition', 'triangle', 'routing', false, NULL, '§1: no token'),
  ('escalationEventDefinition', 'open arrowhead', 'routing', false, NULL, '§1: no token'),
  ('compensateEventDefinition', 'rewind marker', 'routing', false, NULL, 'compensation undoes an effect, and an elimination corrects a count. Nothing is undone here'),
  ('conditionalEventDefinition', 'lined page', 'routing', false, NULL, '§1: no token'),
  ('terminateEventDefinition', 'filled circle', 'routing', false, NULL, '§1: no token'),
  ('linkEventDefinition', 'arrow', 'routing', false, NULL, '§1: no token'),

  ('sequenceFlow', 'solid line, filled arrowhead', 'routing', false,
   NULL, 'F is the call graph and not sequence flow, and BPMN has both. Drawing F as sequence flow claims an execution order the model never states'),
  ('messageFlow', 'dashed line, open arrowhead', 'collaboration', false,
   NULL, 'The named trap. §2: do not re-derive C as a message flow. That reads pm:Layer''s word *independently* as control-flow independence, when the schema''s test is co-movement. A pool''s independence is about tokens; a layer''s is about accounting'),
  ('association', 'dotted line with an open arrowhead', 'artifact', true,
   'pm:Coupling, which is the model''s own falsifier. What an association is for is attaching a textAnnotation; what it can hold is wider: `tAssociation` extends `tArtifact` with `sourceRef` and `targetRef` as required unconstrained QNames, so it is a general typed edge and two lanes are a legal pair. `associationDirection="One"` because C is directed and every consumer reads the direction; BPMN glosses an arrowhead as a direction of flow and a coupling is a dependence, which is safe only because F is drawn as containment and this is the sole line in the emitted notation. The day F is drawn as an edge, reconsider', NULL),
  ('dataAssociation', 'dotted line, open arrowhead', 'data', false,
   NULL, 'Refused on its content model and not on its usual job. Two refusals, both about this element: `sourceRef` and `targetRef` are `xsd:IDREF`, so it cannot cross a document where `tAssociation`''s QNames can. And its `transformation` is a `tFormalExpression`, which is single valued, where every quantity here is three points. That is the sharper form of *BPMN carries no quantity*: it carries one, and a claim is an interval'),

  ('participant', 'pool: a labelled band', 'collaboration', true,
   'a filing. And with no processRef it is a black box, which is first-class BPMN for *a party acts here and what they do is not in this diagram*: the unfilled @scope slot, drawn', NULL),
  ('lane', 'a band subdividing a pool', 'composition', true, 'pm:Layer, and the region it delimits', NULL),
  ('partitionElementRef', 'none, an attribute of a lane', 'composition', false,
   NULL, 'A slot with no filler, and the only place BPMN is the finer of the two. `tLane` carries this and `partitionElement` for what the partition is by, per lane, where this model files one `Scope/basis` per stack. The nearest filler is the absorber buffer and it was tested and refused: 14 filings here have two or more layers sharing one buffer, up to four lanes on `capacity` in one process, so pointing at it would assert a partition the model does not make. A layer''s identity is its name and nothing else, so there is no element to point at. The same state as `performer`, arrived at from the opposite direction'),
  ('laneSet', 'none, it is the subdivision', 'composition', true, 'pm:Stack, a partition claimed exhaustive', NULL),

  ('categoryValueRef', 'none, it is drawn by a group', 'composition', true,
   'pm:Induction, and the element that makes N emittable at all. `tFlowElement` carries it with `maxOccurs="unbounded"`, so a flow node may be in many categories where `flowNodeRef` puts it in one lane. D is a containment and N is a cover, and the direction is reversed: a lane collects its members, a categoryValue collects nobody and the member declares the tie', NULL),
  ('categoryValue', 'none, the group''s label', 'composition', true,
   'a layer that some operation induces into, and it carries the name and not a reference. `tCategoryValue` extends `tBaseElement` and adds one `xs:string`, so the layer arrives as text beside a `lane` of the same name with nothing tying them. The weaker cousin of the callActivity defect: a call loses the layer, this loses only the pointer', NULL),
  ('category', 'none, a rootElement under definitions', 'composition', true,
   'the classification scheme N is, one per document that has an induction to classify. A rootElement, so it is QName addressable across documents even though nothing crosses one yet', NULL),

  ('dataObject', 'rectangle with a folded corner', 'data', false,
   NULL, 'The one that looks like it fits. §1 gives this model what a routed operation takes and commits, which is what this glyph names. It carries a name and a state; a demand here is three points, a unit, a taxonomy and a typed absence. Emitting it would make the diagram appear to carry a magnitude it cannot hold, which is the analyst failure exactly, and §2 already refuses the same thing for a composed layer''s figures'),
  ('dataStore', 'cylinder', 'data', false, NULL, 'persistence, which no filing claims'),
  ('dataInput', 'rectangle, folded corner, open arrow', 'data', false, NULL, 'the dataObject argument, at the activity boundary'),
  ('dataOutput', 'rectangle, folded corner, filled arrow', 'data', false, NULL, 'the dataObject argument, at the activity boundary'),

  ('group', 'dashed rounded rectangle', 'artifact', true,
   'Settled, and the answer is that it is a glyph and not a fact. A group is to `categoryValueRef` what a `lane` is to `flowNodeRef`: the drawn shape of an incidence held on the members. It implies no containment because the incidence it draws permits many parents, which is why N fits it and D does not. It carries `pm:Induction`, and without it the categoryValueRefs are readable and invisible', NULL),
  ('textAnnotation', 'open bracket with text', 'artifact', true,
   'The only element in BPMN that puts words on the canvas, and the third row refused for a property of something adjacent. It read *documentation is spent instead: it attaches to an element where this floats beside one*, which is true and is about the wrong property: a `documentation` is invisible in every rendering and this is not. `diagrams/legends.sqlc` is the population, and a fact carried in `documentation` alone is in the artifact and on no page. Emitted floating, with no `association`, because attaching it would spend that element a second way and the two consolidation filings already carry coupling lines', NULL),
  ('text', 'the annotation''s words', 'artifact', true, 'the note itself, and `tTextAnnotation` carries a `textFormat` this emitter leaves at its default', NULL),

  ('definitions', 'none', 'infrastructure', true, 'the document, and targetNamespace is the filing identity', NULL),
  ('collaboration', 'none', 'infrastructure', true, 'the container the pool lives in', NULL),
  ('process', 'none, it is the pool''s contents', 'composition', true, 'a composition, one .sqlc, an ad-hoc view never built', NULL),
  ('import', 'none', 'infrastructure', true, 'Derived, never declared: the cross-document references. An identity table is a targetNamespace and not an import', NULL),
  ('documentation', 'none', 'infrastructure', true, 'the rank and the provenance, as untyped text that carries the words and not the claim', NULL),
  ('flowNodeRef', 'none', 'composition', true, 'lane membership, which is the orphan law', NULL),
  ('relationship', 'none, it is not drawn at all', 'infrastructure', true,
   '`F` at layer grain, and it sits on the same shelf as the row below it on purpose. Both are BPMN''s extensibility, and they are refused and spent for the same test applied to two different content models: `tRelationship` carries two QNames and a required `type` string, so it names positions in another document and imports nothing, which is what ForeignId does. Not a glyph and never will be: no diagram shows it, so this promotes the fact for a tool and leaves the reader the callActivity name they already had', NULL),
  ('source', 'none', 'infrastructure', true, 'the composed layer end of a relationship, as a QName into this document', NULL),
  ('target', 'none', 'infrastructure', true, 'the part end, as a QName into an imported document. The thing `calledElement` cannot do: a QName there must name a CallableElement and a lane is not one, and the XSD would accept it anyway, which is well-formed and wrong', NULL),
  ('BPMNDiagram', 'none, it is the container of the picture', 'interchange', true,
   'The SVG''s proper place in the document. A document with no plane leaves the SVG stage to derive its geometry from nothing, inventing coordinates, and a cache whose content has no original is a second opinion rather than a cache', NULL),
  ('BPMNPlane', 'none, the surface the shapes sit on', 'interchange', true,
   'the collaboration, drawn. One plane per document, naming the element the picture is of', NULL),
  ('BPMNShape', 'none, it places a glyph', 'interchange', true,
   'the box of every element that gets one: a pool, a lane, a flow node, a group and a text annotation. *Not a group, an association or a text annotation, those are derived* is an argument aimed at the wrong stage: filing a coordinate in a relation is what `diagrams/shapes.sqlc` refuses, while deriving one into the artifact is what the emitter does for every box here. An element with no shape is an element every reader but the renderer beside it loses, and loses without an error', NULL),
  ('Bounds', 'none, x/y/width/height', 'interchange', true,
   'the geometry itself, from the DC namespace. The one place in this pipeline where a number is legitimately drawn, because it is a coordinate and not a magnitude', NULL),
  ('BPMNEdge', 'none, it routes a connector', 'interchange', true,
   'The coupling line''s route, and it is the only edge in the notation. It places a `sequenceFlow`, a `messageFlow`, an `association` or a `dataAssociation`, and of those only `association` is spent here, so an edge in one of these documents is a dependence and can be nothing else. Four `di:waypoint`s describe the gutter run, which is what keeps the line outside both lanes', NULL),
  ('waypoint', 'none, a point on a route', 'interchange', true,
   'a corner of an edge, from the DI namespace proper rather than from `bpmndi` or `dc`. An edge could not be given a route without it, which is why the emitter declares a third namespace', NULL),
  ('BPMNLabel', 'none, it places a label', 'interchange', false,
   NULL, 'where a shape''s text sits. Every label here is placed relative to its own box by one rule, so filing a position per label would be filing what a rule already determines'),
  ('BPMNLabelStyle', 'none, a font', 'interchange', false,
   NULL, 'typography, and the SVG carries one stylesheet. The one DI element that is purely presentational, so it is the only refusal in this block that is about taste rather than derivation'),

  ('extensionElements', 'none', 'infrastructure', false,
   NULL, 'The escape hatch, and refusing it is the boundary. Taking it would put this model inside a BPMN document rather than beside it. ForeignId crosses by naming a position in the other document and never by importing any of it, and an extension element is importing all of it')
) AS n(element, glyph, axis, emitted, stands_for, withheld_because)
